opportunities.title: Regular Grant (online portal)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations, and exempt or excepted organisations according to the Charity Commission guidelines. Applicants must have at least one year of audited or independently examined accounts, work inside the UK or UKOTs, and cannot have received a grant or been declined within the past year.
opportunities.summary: Apply for a regular grant of up to £100,000 via the online Grants Portal. Grants are for core costs and specific projects, subject to eligibility criteria.
